About.missionTitle: Everyone deserves to understand their health.
About.missionBody1: You've just left the doctor's office with a printout full of numbers, abbreviations, and reference ranges. You're not sure if you should be worried. You're not sure what any of it means. And your doctor had eight minutes.
About.missionBody2: That gap — between the data you receive and the understanding you need — is what Meridix Labs exists to close.
About.gapBody1: Lab results are one of the most common touchpoints between a patient and the medical system. Yet most people have no idea what their results actually mean. A value is "flagged" but no one explains why. A diagnosis is given but the implications are never discussed.
About.gapBody2: Meridix Labs provides that missing explanation — not to replace your doctor, but to prepare you for the conversation. We believe an informed patient is a better patient.
About.stat1Label: patients don't understand their lab results
About.stat2Label: of people feel anxious leaving a medical appointment
About.stat3Label: is the average time a doctor spends with a patient
About.value1Desc: Medical language was built for clinicians, not patients. We translate without dumbing down.
About.value2Title: You are the expert on you
About.value2Desc: We provide context. You make decisions. Your autonomy is always respected.
About.value3Desc: We don't store your files. We don't sell your data. We never will.
About.value4Desc: We tell you what's there — calmly, accurately, and with appropriate perspective.
About.value5Desc: Whether you have a PhD or never finished high school, you deserve to understand your own body.
About.value6Desc: We help you prepare for your appointments, not avoid them. Meridix Labs is a starting point, not a substitute.
About.aiBody1: Meridix Labs is powered by Claude, Anthropic's AI model, which is trained to understand complex medical information and explain it clearly. We chose Claude because of its commitment to safety, accuracy, and nuanced reasoning.
About.aiBody2: Every interpretation is generated in real time based on your specific values. There is no one-size-fits-all response. The AI accounts for reference ranges, clinical context, and the specific markers present in your report.
About.specTestsVal: Blood, urine, metabolic, lipid, thyroid, CBC, HbA1c, and more
About.specRetentionVal: Files never stored. Interpretation saved to your account only.
About.specFormatVal: PDF, JPEG, PNG, and most image formats
About.disclaimerBody: Meridix Labs is an educational tool. It is not a medical device, a diagnostic tool, or a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always seek the advice of a qualified physician or other qualified health provider with any questions you may have regarding your health.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.subtitle: Your health data, in plain English.
Privacy.intro: We wrote this policy to be readable, not just legally compliant. If you have questions after reading it, email us.
Privacy.sixtySecBody: We collect your email, name, and any profile info you choose to give us. We process your lab files with AI but never permanently store them. We use Clerk for auth, Supabase for your data, and Anthropic for AI. We don't sell your data. You can delete everything. That's the gist.
Privacy.s1Body: Meridix Labs is an educational health-technology platform operated by Meridix Labs. We are based in the United States. Our service helps users understand their medical lab results, symptoms, and diagnoses through AI-powered explanations.
Privacy.s2aItems: Email address and name (when you create an account)|Profile details you optionally provide: age, sex, medications, allergies, height, weight, health conditions, family history|Lab report files you upload for analysis|Symptom descriptions or diagnosis terms you enter|Goals, supplements, and notes you save to your account
Privacy.s2bItems: IP address and approximate location|Browser type and device type|Pages visited and time spent|Actions taken (button clicks, uploads, feature usage)|Crash reports and error logs
Privacy.s2cBody: If you sign in with Google or another provider via Clerk, we receive your name and email from that provider.
Privacy.s3Items: To provide and improve the Meridix Labs service|To personalize AI interpretations based on your profile|To send account-related emails (verification, password reset)|To analyze usage patterns and improve product features|To detect and prevent fraud or abuse|To comply with legal obligations
Privacy.s4Title: 4. How we store and protect your data
Privacy.s4Body1: Your account data is stored in Supabase, a secure database provider. All data is encrypted at rest using AES-256 and in transit using TLS 1.2+.
Privacy.s4Body2: Lab report files you upload are sent to Anthropic's API for processing and are not permanently stored on our servers. The AI-generated interpretation is saved to your account; the original file is not.
Privacy.s4Body3: We implement role-based access controls, so only your account can access your data. Our team cannot read your lab results or health profile without your explicit consent.
Privacy.s5Title: 5. Third parties we use to run the service
Privacy.s5Intro: We share the minimum necessary data with these providers:
Privacy.s6Body: We use essential cookies for authentication and session management. We use analytics cookies to understand how users interact with the platform. You can disable non-essential cookies in your browser settings. We use a locale cookie (meridix-locale) to remember your language preference.
Privacy.s7Title: 7. How long we keep your data
Privacy.s7Items: Account data: retained as long as your account is active|Lab interpretations: retained until you delete them or your account|Usage analytics: aggregated and anonymized after 90 days|Deleted accounts: all personal data purged within 30 days of deletion
Privacy.s8Items: Access: request a copy of all data we hold about you|Correction: update or correct any inaccurate information|Deletion: delete your account and all associated data at any time|Portability: request your data in a machine-readable format|Opt-out: unsubscribe from any marketing communications
Privacy.s9Items: Meridix Labs is NOT a covered entity under HIPAA. We are an educational tool, not a healthcare provider.|Your lab files are never stored on our servers permanently — only the AI-generated interpretation is saved.|We do not share your health information with insurance companies, employers, or any third party for commercial purposes.|Do not use Meridix Labs in a medical emergency.
Privacy.s10Body: Meridix Labs is not intended for children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us immediately.
Privacy.s11Body: Meridix Labs is operated from the United States. If you are accessing the service from outside the United States, your data may be transferred to and processed in the United States, where data protection laws may differ from your jurisdiction.
Privacy.s12Body: We will notify you of material changes by email or by a prominent notice on the platform at least 14 days before the change takes effect. Continued use of the service after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
Privacy.s13Body: If you have questions about this policy or want to exercise your rights, email us at:
